triggers.name: new_notification
triggers.title: New notification
triggers.description: New notification in Nasuni Management Console
triggers.help: Creates a new job for each new notification in Nasuni Management Console. When started, this trigger will pull in all records from the beginning of time.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in Nasuni Management Console (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own NMC action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your NMC connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: auto_caching_for_file
actions.title: Set auto caching mode for file/directory
actions.description: Enable auto caching mode for file/directory in Nasuni Management Console
actions.help: Allows you to turn on auto caching mode for a given file/directory in a specified volume and filer. You can optionally choose to cache only metadata

input.name: async_await
input.label: Wait for enabling of auto-caching mode to complete?
input.hint: By default, workato will not wait for action to be fully completed. If set to true, recipe will wait for job to be processed, if set to false (default), then job will not wait for action to be complet…

input.name: volume_guid
input.label: Volume GUID
input.hint: Volume identifier.

input.name: filer_serial
input.label: Filer serial number
input.hint: Filer object identifier.

input.name: path
input.label: Folder/File path
input.hint: Enter folder or File path.

input.name: mode
input.label: Mode
input.hint: The folder to enable pinning on and optionally the mode.
